prompt: What is the most recent film to join the top 10 highest-grossing films of all time?
answer: **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** is the most recent film to enter the all-time top 10. It crossed into the list in August 2026 after surpassing *Inside Out 2*, with approximately **$1.72 billion** worldwide at the time.
